diagnosis: Atypical melanocytic naevus of genital type.
legend: Sections reveal compound melanocytic proliferation composed of large irregular junctional nests with retraction artifact, composed of medium to large epithelioid pigmented melanocytes. The dermal component is composed of small nests of melanocytes that show progressive maturation with dermal descent. There are broad zones of subepithelial fibrosis, and the rete architecture is preserved. Confluence, pagetoid distribution and concentric eosinophilic fibroplasia are absent.
